items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: Well that's what Monetta used to teach me.

ctx.x: Did you ever learn anything about listening to jazz musicians? Oh yeah. I learned a lot about listening to a Louis Armstrong role. About timing? Timing? No. I didn't. Who would you pick up? Well I got my timing when I first started because this music teacher I had, Professor Tull, he was strict on time. And he had an old method of counting. You know like a musician counts with a foot, one, two, one, two, three, four. But he didn't teach that way. He taught down, left, right, up. Instead of one, two, three, four,…
Well that's what Monetta used to teach me. I believe it was the same. Yeah, it was the same.
All of the old professors used to teach that way. Yeah.
